faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Answers to common questions about using Kriyanto for document and research workflows.

items.question: Do I need technical experience to use Kriyanto?
items.answer: No. Kriyanto is designed for natural-language search, summaries, and document questions without setup complexity.

items.question: What is Kriyanto?
items.answer: Kriyanto is an AI workspace for searching, summarizing, and understanding documents and research.

items.question: Can I use Kriyanto with existing documents?
items.answer: Yes. Upload your existing files and ask questions across them in plain language.

items.question: Can teams collaborate in Kriyanto?
items.answer: Team workflows are supported through shared projects, saved research, and plan-based access controls.

items.question: Does Kriyanto support web research?
items.answer: Yes. Kriyanto can combine uploaded document context with broader web research when needed.

items.question: Can I try Kriyanto before purchasing a plan?
items.answer: Yes, you can start with a trial and upgrade when your usage grows.
